in_summary.they_want: The USACE requires a contractor to plant, monitor, and maintain native forest habitat on approximately 165.4 acres (plus a 10.4-acre option) in the Fargo-Moorhead area over a 3-year period. The work includes site preparation, planting native trees/grasses/forbs, and controlling invasive species to meet specific performance standards for environmental mitigation.
in_summary.delivery_locations: Cass County, North Dakota and Clay County, Minnesota.

acceptance_criteria: A mutually agreed upon site walk-through must be conducted in Year 3 early enough to allow for correction of any identified deficiencies.
The Contracting Officer will provide a list of deficiencies and acceptable repairs (e.g., disking, reseeding, localized herbicide treatment).
Final site acceptance occurs after the Contracting Officer approves all repairs and will not occur prior to the end of the growing season in Year 3.
Final Vegetation Performance Standards must be met by the end of the performance period.
Floodplain Forest: >450 seedlings/acre >30" tall; >300 seedlings/acre >42" tall; <25 woody invasive stems/acre; <15% herbaceous invasive cover; No one tree species >40% of total abundance.
Oak Savanna: >300 seedlings/acre >30" tall; >250 seedlings/acre >42" tall; >50% native forbs/grasses cover; <25 woody invasive stems/acre; <15% herbaceous invasive cover.
Bank Stabilization: >600 seedlings/acre >30" tall; >300 seedlings/acre >42" tall; <25 woody invasive stems/acre; <15% herbaceous invasive cover.
Forest Preservation: <25 woody invasive stems >12" tall per acre; <15% relative aerial cover of herbaceous invasive species.

attachment_summaries.attachment_2_technical_lists: Provides a list of Government-approved herbicides for use in vegetation control, noting which have aquatic formulations and their application type (pre-emergent vs. post-emergent). Examples include: Glyphosate, Triclopyr, Imazapyr, 2,4-D + Dicamba, Clopyralid.
attachment_summaries.attachment_4_site_maps_layouts: Contains maps of the various work sites. Site IDs, counties, and work types are detailed in the PWS. Base contract includes sites 8a, 22a, 32, 33, 34, 38b, 42a, 44, and Oxbow Country Club #2. Option 1 includes sites 8b, 22b, and 42b. Work types include Floodplain Forest Planting, Oak Savanna Planting, Bank Stabilization, and Forest Preservation.

scope_categories.description: Activities including mowing, broadcast herbicide spray, discing, and burning to prepare sites for planting.
Establishment of three distinct planting zones: Bank Stabilization, Floodplain Forest, and Oak Savanna, using specified seed mixes, live stakes, and bare-root/container trees.
Control of woody and herbaceous invasive species within designated forest preservation areas using mechanical and chemical methods.
Three years of ongoing site maintenance (mowing, spot spraying, etc.) and annual vegetation monitoring with detailed reporting to ensure performance standards are met.
Placement of approximately 30 boulders to prevent vehicular access at the entrance to Site 38b.
